column3: Not touching a woman is recast as abstaining from sexual relations.
The second purpose, being together again, is recast as an imperative.
“Believing” is supplied with wife; brother is rendered “believing husband.”
Walking is expanded as leading the assigned life.
“The situation he was in” is supplied; with God is recast as “when God called him.”
Remain as he is expands be thus.
Released from a wife is rendered “free of commitment.”
“In this life” replaces in the flesh; “want to” and “this” are supplied.
